venues.name: Skyline Foundry
venues.description: Industrial-style rooftop venue suitable for startup mixers, product launches, and private evening events.

venues.name: Harbor Loft
venues.description: Flexible loft space with exposed brick, stage lighting, and a projector setup for presentations.

venues.name: Cambridge Private Table
venues.description: Private dining venue designed for team dinners, founder meetings, and client hospitality.

documents.title: Skyline Foundry FAQ
documents.content: Skyline Foundry supports startup mixers, networking events, and demo days. Outside catering is not allowed. Built-in AV support includes wireless microphones, projector output, and a presentation monitor.

documents.title: Harbor Loft Policies
documents.content: Harbor Loft allows outside catering with prior approval. The venue supports launch events and internal company all-hands. Cancellation with full refund is available up to 14 days before the event.

documents.title: Cambridge Private Table Notes
documents.content: Cambridge Private Table is best for small executive dinners and team gatherings. The space does not support large-scale AV setups, but it does provide stable Wi-Fi and a private dining room.
